title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1970-09-17

ai_review.summary: A cranky old audience tape that’s still worth a spin for its standout Dark Star performance.
ai_review.review: The recording is an aged audience source with noticeable hiss and a “cranky” sound, making it less than pristine.  Nevertheless, reviewers rave about the Dark Star from this show, calling it one of the most interesting and best‑ever versions, even though the exact date is debated.  The performance shines despite the modest audio quality.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong praise for Dark Star (show quality high) balanced against comments that the tape is old and noisy (recording quality fair).

recording_quality.technical_notes: Cranky, aged audience tape with hiss and occasional muddiness; still intelligible enough to enjoy.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific comments on set structure or pacing.
